chunks: Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl narrated from Yūnus al-Shaybānī, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: “What if a drop of blood appears in the nutfah?”

He said: “For one drop, one-tenth of the compensation of the nutfah applies, which is twenty-two dinars.” He said: I asked, “What if two drops fall?” He said: “Then twenty-four dinars.” I said: “What if three drops fall?” He said: “Then twenty-six dinars.” I said: “Then four?” He said: “Twenty-eight; and for five, thirty. If it exceeds half, then it is calculated according to that until it becomes an ʿalaqah; and when it is an ʿalaqah, then it is forty dinars.”

key_terms.النُّطْفَةِ: the sperm-drop or earliest stage of embryonic formation
key_terms.النِّصْفِ: half; the point after which compensation continues proportionally
key_terms.دِينَاراً: a dinar, the monetary unit used here for legal compensation
key_terms.عَلَقَةً: the clinging clot stage of embryonic development
key_terms.عُشْرُ النُّطْفَةِ: one-tenth of the compensation assigned to the nutfah stage
key_terms.قَطْرَةُ دَمٍ: a drop of blood appearing in the nutfah

ai.seo_question: What is the blood money for a nutfah when drops of blood appear in it according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on graded blood money for harm to the early embryonic stage, beginning from the nutfah when blood appears within it. It specifies incremental amounts in dinars according to development, until the stage reaches ʿalaqah, at which point the compensation is forty dinars.
